description: While you build a model in Blender for the user, push an APPLIED copy of your working .blend after each step (body done, wheels done, materials done): the user's Blender page shows it as a 3D preview they can orbit. A draft is not a saved version: one draft per user, the newest wins, kept 24 hours. Answers a one-time ticket (5 minutes) and the draft endpoint (URL, method, Authorization header; the body is the file's raw bytes); sending it needs file access where the .blend is. Apply modifiers on a copy and pack textures before pushing; save the real file with r3_blender_upload when the user is happy. Up to 20 MB. Needs the blender:upload right.

model.description: The model's name, as the page shows it: "monster-truck" (the same name you will save it under).

name: r3_blender_draft_push

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Show your work in progress on the Blender page
